page_title: BAY 2-1 RBL | Bayern Munich v RB Leipzig 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Marco Rose has decided to substitute David Raum and he is replaced by Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig).
90+2' The substitution has been made. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has replaced Benjamin Sesko.
90+1' The attendance is 75000.

90+1' 2 - 1 Goal! Great play by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting releases Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A dangerous looking corner kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared to safety by the defence.
87' It's time for a substitution. Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Xavi Simons.
86' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
86' The ball is cleared after Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
84' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes it short.
84' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) replaces Jamal Musiala.
84' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
81' The substitution is prepared. Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
80' A decent cross gives Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
78' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
74' Here is a change. Amadou Haidara is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
73' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lois Openda walks off.
72' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Dani Olmo passes the ball to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Manuel Neuer couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
68' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to send the ball in.
67' Yellow card. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
66' What was Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
65' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Leroy Sane is replaced by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
65' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thomas Muller.
62' Great touch by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
59' Booking. Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) receives a caution from the referee.
58' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

56' 1 - 0 Goal! Jamal Musiala puts Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
55' Manuel Neuer blocks Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig)'s effort from the edge of the box.

53' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
53' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) prepares to take a corner kick.

53' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Manuel Neuer! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
51' A cross by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
50' The resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the defence. Bayern Munich get a corner.
44' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
43' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
42' The ball falls to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Janis Blaswich makes an easy save.
41' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
40' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
39' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
38' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
37' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
31' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) heads on.
26' Looks like Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
24' The ratio of the ball possession is 64:36.
23' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
18' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
16' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
12' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
10' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
9' David Raum (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
8' Great teamplay by RB Leipzig as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

5' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) creates some space for himself near the penalty spot and aims a decent header towards the left side of the goal, but Janis Blaswich leaps and diverts the ball onto the post.
5' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The referee of today's match will be Sascha Stegemann.
